create_random_agent: create a RandomAgent instance that takes random legal actions in a Hanabi game
initialize_random_agent: initialize a RandomAgent with a config dictionary for Hanabi game play
run_random_agent_act: run the RandomAgent.act method with an observation to get a random legal move
